body:
I am a slight (in terms of build) yet experienced 21 year old user. I have extensive experience with MDMA, cocaine, ketamine, LSD and a lot of benzos. As I am typing this I am just coming up from about 100mg of methiopropamine. I have never tried this chemical before. As a bit of context I've had half a bottle of red wine and I was feeling quite sleepy when I took the line. And I have to say it has perked me up and kicked the shit out of me. I feel a slight mental buzz but physically I am incredibly awake. I will not redose as it is a research chemical and I want to play it safe but I will say this one line is impressive.
